Market today: The jobs report is the main driver, showing strength that could keep rates higher for longer. This is a headwind for your tech/chip concentration, especially leveraged names.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -54.45% and SPAL is a TRIM at -32.68%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay and are underperforming significantly. SMH is also a TRIM at -11.23%.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the market digests the strong jobs data and its implications for interest rates. Your leveraged tech positions are particularly vulnerable.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your high-risk, leveraged positions given the current macro environment.
plays: Trim SPAL: This leveraged ETF is down significantly and decays. Consider reducing exposure.
Trim SMH: This semiconductor ETF is underperforming. Respect the stop at 540.
Consider trimming SOXL: This leveraged ETF is a SELL and down heavily. Re-evaluate its place in your book.
